CardDose.title: CardDose
CardDose.description:
A regimen as the user recorded it from the doctor's instructions. A `schedule.type` of
"prn" means as needed: the app must say so, not show it as a fixed dose.

CardStoppedMedication.title: CardStoppedMedication
CardStoppedMedication.description: An immunosuppressant stopped in the last 14 days (Q37): its name and stop day.

DoseAlertOut.title: DoseAlertOut
DoseAlertOut.description:
What a dose alert was about, and what is recorded for that dose now (decision 3: a push
already sent is not withdrawn; the app shows the current state instead).

Elapsed.title: Elapsed
Elapsed.description:
Time since the transplant, never more than can be true (counted from the last possible
day of a month/year-only date); `approximate`: show "≈" or the year, not a day count.

LabResultOut.title: LabResultOut
LabResultOut.description: One row as read from the document; nothing in it is judged here (rules 4-5).

LastDoseOut.title: LastDoseOut
LastDoseOut.description: The last logged dose of a linked medicine before the sample - a fact only.

LevelStatsOut.title: LevelStatsOut
LevelStatsOut.description:
Numbers only (H15): no threshold, colour or judgement - the app adds the reviewed text.
The mean, SD and the values themselves go to a doctor only; everyone else gets CV% (Q63-7,
physician 2026-11-18).

ManualReport.title: ManualReport
ManualReport.description:
A result typed in by hand: the sample's date (and whether its time is known) always
said; optionally the profile's own scan or photo it was typed from.

RegimenIn.title: RegimenIn
RegimenIn.description:
A dose and schedule from `effective_from` on, as the doctor instructed.

daily/weekly: amounts per time (`schedule.times[].amount`, e.g. 2 mg at 08:00 and 1.5 mg
at 20:00) with one `dose_unit`, or no amounts at all. prn: `dose_amount` + `dose_unit`
(or neither). `dose_unit` "other" needs `dose_unit_text`.

RejectBody.title: RejectBody
RejectBody.description: `critical_seen`: the person saw that the draft may hold a critical value (H5).

ResultPatch.title: ResultPatch
ResultPatch.description:
Only the fields sent change; `clear` empties a field. `acknowledge`: issues the person
looked at and keeps as they are - sent alone or with a test pick, never with new text.

ShareLinkCreatedOut.title: ShareLinkCreatedOut
ShareLinkCreatedOut.description: Shown once: neither the token nor the PIN can be read again.

SharedRecordOut.title: SharedRecordOut
SharedRecordOut.description: Only the sections the link includes are present (the others are null).

SummaryOut.title: SummaryOut
SummaryOut.description: Counts only: no "on time" threshold, no colour, no judgement (Q23, rule 10).

device_token.title: Device Token
device_token.description: Returned once when this device becomes trusted; store securely.

possibly_critical.title: Possibly Critical
possibly_critical.description: The lab marked it critical, or its printed critical range could not be used: shown as 'check the document', never called critical (Q60).

possibly_critical.title: Possibly Critical
possibly_critical.description: The lab marked it critical, or its printed critical range could not be used: shown as 'check the document', never called critical (Q60).

VitalsIn.title: VitalsIn
VitalsIn.description:
One reading: a single kind, or blood pressure (systolic + diastolic, pulse optional)
measured together.
